description: This source file implements the Netlink class and related parsing classes for interacting with Linux kernel netlink sockets, handling network interface info, addresses, routing, and rules within the quic namespace.

classes.name: LinkInfoParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to network link information, matching interface name and populating LinkInfo structure.

classes.name: LocalAddressParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages for local IP addresses associated with a specific network interface.

classes.name: UnknownParser
classes.description: Handles generic netlink messages of unknown type, primarily for logging.

classes.name: RoutingRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages related to routing rules and populates a vector of RoutingRule objects.

classes.name: IpRuleParser
classes.description: Parses netlink messages for IP rules and populates a vector of IpRule objects.

methods.name: Netlink::OpenSocket
methods.description: Opens a netlink socket and binds to it.

methods.name: Netlink::CloseSocket
methods.description: Closes the netlink socket if open.

methods.name: Netlink::GetLinkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves link (interface) information for a given interface name.

methods.name: Netlink::GetAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a specific network interface.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeLocalAddress
methods.description: Adds or deletes a local IP address on a network interface.

methods.name: Netlink::GetRouteInfo
methods.description: Retrieves routing rules from the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeRoute
methods.description: Adds, removes, or replaces a routing rule in the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::GetRuleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves IP rules from the kernel.

methods.name: Netlink::ChangeRule
methods.description: Adds, removes, or attempts to replace an IP rule.

methods.name: Netlink::Send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message via the socket.

methods.name: Netlink::Recv
methods.description: Receives netlink messages, handling multi-part replies and dispatching to a parser.
